questions.prompt: What is special about the vehicle Anna chooses for the tour?
options: It can travel on roads and on water.
It travels on water but has no wheels.
answers: It can travel on roads and on water.
questions.evidence: It’s the famous DC Ducks -- the boat with wheels! We will ride on the road and then sail on the water!
questions.explanation: Anna把它叫作有轮子的船，并明确说先在路上行驶、再到水上航行。这个回答不依靠看车辆图像。不是地下交通，也不能只抓住boat这个词就忽略wheels和road。

spokenEvidence.quote: It’s the famous DC Ducks -- the boat with wheels! We will ride on the road and then sail on the water!

questions.prompt: Why does Anna like hearing Fun Facts during the tour?
options: They make the tour more interesting.
They make the vehicle travel faster.
They replace the need to see any landmarks.
answers: They make the tour more interesting.
questions.evidence: a tour is so much more interesting with Fun Facts, like that one.
questions.explanation: Anna明确说有这些趣闻，游览会有趣得多。她没有说趣闻能提高交通速度或替代看地标。这里识别is more interesting这一评价与Fun Facts的关系，而不是根据知识内容自行编造效果。

spokenEvidence.quote: a tour is so much more interesting with Fun Facts, like that one.

questions.prompt: How does Penelope present the idea that the boy is the Captain’s son?
options: As something the boy has directly confirmed.
As something she already knows about his family.
As a possible explanation rather than a confirmed fact.
answers: As a possible explanation rather than a confirmed fact.
questions.evidence: Maybe - maybe he’s the Captain’s son and he helps his dad on tours!
questions.explanation: Penelope两次说maybe，说明是在猜一种可能解释。对话没有让男孩确认父子关系，也没有说她本来就认识这家人。读听时需要保留说话人的确定程度，不能把可能性改写成事实。

spokenEvidence.quote: Maybe - maybe he’s the Captain’s son and he helps his dad on tours!

questions.prompt: On which side does Anna say the Washington Monument is?
questions.evidence: the Washington Monument is on the left!
questions.explanation: Anna亲口用on the left说明方位，所以选左侧；无需借助镜头判断。right和behind都不是她在这一句里说出的关系。题目限定Anna的说法，不根据旅游线路或地图自行推断。

spokenEvidence.quote: the Washington Monument is on the left!

questions.prompt: What does the boy say about the bathrooms in his own home?
options: His large family shares only one.
Every family member has a separate one.
His home has as many as the White House.
answers: His large family shares only one.
questions.evidence: I live in a house with my mom, four sisters, two aunts and only one bathroom!
questions.explanation: 男孩列出妈妈、四个姐妹、两位姨妈后说only one bathroom，说明一大家人共用一间。32间是他说的白宫信息，不是他家的数量，也不是每人各有一间。注意比较对象，避免只记住对话里最大的数字。

spokenEvidence.quote: I live in a house with my mom, four sisters, two aunts and only one bathroom!

questions.prompt: What reason does Anna give for offering the boy money?
options: He has asked them to buy a souvenir.
It is polite to tip a tour guide.
He has sold them a boat ticket.
answers: It is polite to tip a tour guide.
questions.evidence: It is polite to tip your tour guide!
questions.explanation: Anna把给钱解释为给导游小费的礼貌做法。题目只问她给出的理由，并不替故事确认男孩究竟是不是正式导游。没有说他卖票或要求买纪念品，不能把旅游常见消费补成这里的情节。

spokenEvidence.quote: It is polite to tip your tour guide!
